title: How The Immune System ACTUALLY Works – IMMUNE
summary: A Kurzgesagt animation giving a big-picture tour of the human immune system, its organs, transport network, and the cells it produces every day. It accompanies their IMMUNE book.
why: HN commenters suggest it as a simple, well-made introduction to how immune responses work when discussing infection, T cells or chronic illness.

quote.text: I like the series that Kurzgesagt made on the immune system as a way to explain this complexity a little more simply.
